annotations.title: Old criminal code to new code mapper

description: Maps a section of a repealed criminal law — the Indian Penal Code 1860, the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 or the Indian Evidence Act 1872 — to its counterpart in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita or Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023, with the transitional rule. Use for IPC-to-BNS, CrPC-to-BNSS and Evidence Act-to-BSA conversion questions (e.g. "what is IPC 420 in the BNS?").

code.description: The repealed law: "ipc" (Indian Penal Code), "crpc" (Code of Criminal Procedure) or "iea" (Indian Evidence Act)

section.description: Section of the repealed law, e.g. "420", "Section 498A", "§138", "167(2)", "65B"

name: map_old_code_section
title: Old criminal code to new code mapper
